title: Have the test-run registration adapter request TermAl's bounded registration view, once TermAl serves one
outcome: Have the test-run registration adapter request TermAl's bounded registration view, once TermAl serves one
acceptance: scripts/test-run-registration.mjs confirms a run's registration through TermAl's bounded registration view (only the run and source fields it uses), so a run with a large uncommitted delta registers instead of being refused as invalid-response
The adapter's 64 KiB response bound stays in place, and a test exercises a registration whose full TermAl detail would exceed it
